The decision numbers for items 7, 8, 9 and 11 ((EU) 2015/1874, 2015/1875, 2015/1876, 2017/369) were checked with four differently worded prompts; the answers agreed, the footnote OJ pages rise in order (L 275 pp. 32, 35, 38, 43), and a search for any 2013 or 2014 decision number on the page found none. acts.scrutiny: footnote 11: 'The scrutiny period for Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2022/1552 is ongoing at time of writing.'

COM_2022_251.note: The report prints the 18 March 2022 act as '(EU) 2022/1552' in item (d) and footnote 11. Asked directly, the tool said the document does not print '2022/1326' or 'C(2022)'.
